Preparation Tips
Wash wild rice before cooking.  The basic
preparation recipe for wild rice is to place
1 cup of wild rice in a saucepan with 4 cups
of water (chicken or beef stock can be
added for flavor).  Bring the mixture to a
boil and then reduce the heat.  Simmer the
rice covered for 40 to 50 minutes until it
is tender and most of the grains have split
evenly.
Serving Suggestions
Wild rice is mixed into a multitude of
dishes, from everyday cooking to gourmet
creations.  Use cooked wild rice in place of
pasta products in casseroles or salads.  It
can be used in place of bulgur in tabbouleh
salads or as the base for stir-fry dishes
instead of white rice.  Mixed with vegetables
or small amounts of meat, poultry, or fish,
wild rice provides the base for an excellent
entrée.

naturally present in flour, it produces a gas
called carbon dioxide.  Bread rises as the
gluten in the dough traps this gas.  Yeast is
also responsible for bread’s delicious aroma
and gives it its flavor.
Salt—Bread can be made without this
staple, but salt does several things when it
is added to dough.  It adds flavor, helps
strengthen the gluten, and helps regulate
yeast production.
